data.narrative:
Tritone Technologies is a Series B robotics and manufacturing company founded by Ofer Ben-Zur. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of 9 private companies and 1 public comparable (ticker 277810.KQ), with direct methodology applied to 3 same-sector, same-stage private peers: Generalist AI ($2.0B), Bedrock Robotics ($1.8B), and Dexterity ($1.6B).

The peer-median method, the sole applicable triangulation approach given available data, yields an implied valuation of $1.8B. This reflects the median across the three-company peer sample, with the range spanning $1.6B to $2.0B. The peer set is reasonably cohesive, suggesting limited outlier risk within the immediate comparison universe.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $1.5B to $2.0B, centered at $1.8B. Key uncertainties include limited visibility into Tritone's revenue, growth trajectory, and unit economics relative to peers; the modest sample size of three direct comparables; and the nascent stage of frontier robotics valuations more broadly. A full assessment would benefit from revenue multiples, customer concentration data, and capital efficiency metrics to stress-test the peer-median result. The wide dispersion across public markets in this sector also suggests execution risk warrants concentrated scrutiny.
